notes: Four roles in nine years. I joined the support center in 2017 and sorted points complaints into five types for the knowledge base. As team lead in 2019 I pushed for a change to how points are credited, and points complaints fell from 1,240 to 380 a month. That taught me one fixed rule beats ten more agents. In 2021 I moved to membership operations and redesigned birthday coupons. Since 2023 I've led a team of six, and we rebuilt top-up cards and lapsed-member win-back.
